can you fix this error also [js.err] [dispatch] error id=5312 type=onClick: buildings: 'custom:override-back-material' is not a registry material — skins assign THE material system Error: buildings: 'custom:override-back-material' is not a registry material — skins assign THE material system
    at checkSkin (<anonymous>:86539:15)
    at writeTargetSkin (<anonymous>:86591:7)
    at Object.applyPaintTargetSkin (<anonymous>:86687:9)
    at Object.run (<anonymous>:87358:40)

resolution: Fixed the building paint apply error by keeping newly saved custom materials visible in-process immediately after save; the building validator can now resolve custom:override-back-material through the material system instead of throwing before localstore catches up. Added a regression for stale same-dispatch localstore reads.
